note: Measured taxonomy. Cut points sit on real gaps in the 94-skin accent-hue distribution, not on an even wheel, so every shelf carries at least four skins. Applied to the DARK accent; if a skin has no dark accent, the light one is used.

axes.hue: hue angle of the signature accent in OKLCH, degrees 0-360
axes.chroma_floor: C < 0.04 is achromatic: the accent carries no hue to name

wrapper.note: An angle below 2.8 is the same family as an angle above 322: the wheel wraps.

naming.register: each family is named after the object the colour is named after (persimmon, amber, lemon, fern, teal, cobalt, indigo, violet, rose)
divergences: Lane B proposed Rose and Magenta as separate families; the catalogue has only 2 accents between 322 and 345, so a split would leave a shelf of 2. One family, named Rose, carries all 7.
Lane B proposed Slate for achromatic. Rejected: the host ships a theme called slate (dropped in D6) and Tailwind's olive/slate carry different meanings. Neutral says what it means.
Lane A's cuts leave teal and azure at 2 each. These cuts sit on the measured gaps instead, so every shelf carries at least 4.
naming.collision_check: no family name matches or paraphrases a pack (Earth, Cyberpunk, Zen, Retro, Noir, core), and no category id equals 'earth'.
